Message.Name: Login Message
Message.Description: The first message the Member process sends to the GRP after connection to the GRP is established. Failure to login before sending any other message type will result in the connection being dropped by the GRP.

Message.Name: Login Response Message
Message.Description: Sent by the GRP to the Member process in response to a Login message. The Status field reflects an accepted login or the reason the session was not accepted. If login fails, the connection will be dropped after the Login Response message is sent.

Message.Name: Gap Request Message
Message.Description: Used by a Member's process to request retransmission of a sequenced message (or messages) by one of Cboe Canada's gap servers.

Field.Name: Unit
Field.Description: Unit that the gap is requested for.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Sequence of first message (lowest sequence in range).

Message.Name: Gap Response Message
Message.Description: Sent by the GRP in response to a Gap Request message. The Unit and Sequence fields will match the values supplied in the Gap Request message. A Gap Response message, with a Status of Accepted or reason for failure, will be sent for each Gap Request message received by the GRP.

Field.Name: Unit
Field.Description: Unit the gap was requested for.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Sequence of first message in request.

Field.Name: Status
Field.Description: Accepted or reason for reject. All non-A status codes should be interpreted as a reject.

Value.Name: Out of range (ahead of sequence or too far behind)
Count request limit for one gap request exceeded
